title: Fourteen Winters and One Short Desk
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：education　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 education 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my teacher ① gave an education that no parent in the village would have paid for, and he said the giving was the whole of the winter. The ② education, meaning the schooling and not the breeding, ran fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; an education, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left unpaid for.

Every ③ education in that village had the same short desk at the end of it, and the ④ education at the end, meaning the one they kept for the girls and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An education, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to pay; my teacher said the paying is the part that fills fourteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the education was the whole of the story, meaning the breeding and not the schooling. The ⑥ education, meaning the breeding and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody praises and nobody tests; education, he said, is either something you give or the only word that means both a schooling and a breeding. He said the breeding is the part they remember.

By 1955 the ⑦ education had become a line in a charter, and the charter had become an argument about the short desk. The ⑧ education of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in January, was one village and fourteen winters of paying; education, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to pay. She said the paying was never mentioned.

The ⑨ education I remember is the one named in the charter, which ended in 1967 and is still described as the quietest in the village. An ⑩ education, my mother said in 1969, is the only one that improves by being paid for; every education, she said, is a breeding that has agreed to look like a schooling. She said the breeding was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 教育；学业（指那个村子里办过的那一种）
B. n. 教育；学业（指那种教育本身，与教养相对）
C. 固定搭配：give an education 给予一种教育
D. n. 教育；学业（指留给女童的那一种）
E. n. 教育；学业（抽象总称，指一个村子的办学之事）
F. n. 教育；学业（指章程上写到、被列名的那一种）
G. n. 教养；所受的教育（指故事里人人都夸却无人检验的那样东西）
H. n. 教养（抽象总称，指人人都夸却无人检验的那种东西）

items.q: gave an education that no parent in the village would have paid for
The education, meaning the schooling and not the breeding
the education was the whole of the story
the education had become a line in a charter

answers.why: give an education 意为“给予一种教育”，1946 年老师办了一种村子里没有一位家长肯为之付钱的教育。
education 意为“教育、学业”，指那种教育本身而不是教养，它经过了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
education 意为“教育、学业”，指那个村子里的每一种教育，每一种到头都有同一张小小的课桌。
education 意为“教育、学业”，指留给女童的那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
education 意为“教养、所受的教育”，指故事里人人都夸却无人检验的那样东西，叔叔说这份教养就是那个故事的全部。
education 意为“教养”，指人人都夸却无人检验的那种东西而不是那种教育，是故事里人人都夸、却无人检验的东西。
education 意为“教育、学业”，指章程上写到、被列名的那一种，到 1955 年这种教育成了章程里的一行。
education 意为“教育、学业”，老师一月写道，整件事的办学之事是一个村子和十四个冬天的付学费。
education 意为“教育、学业”，我记得的是章程上列名的那一种，1967 年结束了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一种。
education 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，一种教育是唯一会因为被好好付学费而变得更好的东西。
